mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.order_id, r.worker_id, r.arrive_time, r.arrive_location, r.investigate_note, r.repair_desc, r.fault_reason, r.replace_parts, r.finish_time, r.result_file_id, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, u.nick_name as worker_name, f.file_name as result_file_name from repair_record r left join sys_user u on r.worker_id = u.user_id left join sys_file f on r.result_file_id = f.file_id and f.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into repair_record ( order_id, worker_id, arrive_time, arrive_location, investigate_note, repair_desc, fault_reason, replace_parts, finish_time, result_file_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{orderId}, #{workerId}, #{arriveTime}, #{arriveLocation}, #{investigateNote}, #{repairDesc}, #{faultReason}, #{replaceParts}, #{finishTime}, #{resultFileId}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
